newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real ends flat on low dollar liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real ends flat on low dollar liquidity.

text.p: Brazil's real ended steady at 1.0615 reais per dollar in the commercial foreign exchange market on continued low dollar liquidity, dealers said.

Repeating Tuesday's move, the Central Bank sold dollars at 1.0615 reais per greenback late in the session to increase liquidity and maintain the dollar within the trading level of 1.0565 and 1.0615 reais per dollars, they added.
Preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a deficit of around six million reais Wednesday at 1630 local/1930 GMT, bankers said.
In the interbank foreign exchange floating rate market, the real rose a slight 0.01 percent to end at 1.0618 reais per dollar.
In the illegal parallel market, the real closed flat at 1.100 reais per greenback.
